summary: KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) announcing the manager's determination, as of September 21, 2026, of the transactional net asset value per share for its share classes as of August 31, 2026. Class D shares were valued at $35.86, Class I-Series 1 at $36.17, Class S at $35.48, Class U at $35.47, Class R-D at $35.87, Class R-I at $36.14, Class R-U at $35.17, and Classes F, G and H each at $38.66. This is a periodic NAV publication, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or risk-arb angle applies.
